Subject: Stakeholder map & MAP — next steps (FinPay)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum:

Key stakeholders we mapped during the call:
- Elena Garcia — Product lead / primary champ (you)
- Rajesh Singh — Head of Security (owns security buy)
- Procurement (procurement@finpay.com) — contract & T&Cs
- Victor Huang — CFO (economic buyer; you indicated we should loop him into pricing once we have a MAP)

Decision criteria you shared:
- Latency under 200ms 99th pct for main flows
- SOC 2 or equivalent evidence for security posture
- Clear unit economics (cost per 1M tokens and embedding costs)
- Ability to pin model versions and private deployment option for PII workloads

Proposed MAP (high level) — attached as FinPay-MAP-draft.xlsx and FinPay-Security-Questionnaire.pdf:
1) Week 1 (Feb 22-28): Redwood to provide MAP draft, SOC2 evidence, and data-flow diagram.
2) Week 2 (Mar 1-7): Security review w/ Rajesh; procurement receives contract draft for timeline.
3) Week 3 (Mar 8-14): Pilot plan + test data exchange; pricing confirmed with Victor.
4) Week 4 (Mar 15-21): Exec review and decision.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Elena: confirm the stakeholder list and if Victor should be on the next call or emailed the MAP summary.
- Rajesh: I'll follow up separately to get any additional security checklist items.
- Procurement: please confirm typical review SLAs (e.g., 2 weeks for standard SOW/MSA review).

I'll loop Rishi and Michael on the technical/security responses. If that timeline looks reasonable I can update the MAP and send a DocuSign link for an MSA placeholder so procurement can start internal routing.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
